payload.name: Enterprise-Architecture-Design
payload.description: Transform the Google Online Boutique (GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo) into a real enterprise-grade e-commerce application while preserving its existing architecture as much as possible. The user wants a comprehensive architecture design document covering all existing services, new enterprise components, PostgreSQL schemas, Kafka topics, API Gateway design, authentication with Keycloak, OpenSearch search, S3 object storage, and detailed architecture diagrams.
